origin.description: Implicit Newmark step for one second-order equation. The state holds the value and its first derivative, and each stage is a Broyden root.
origin.usage: newmark(f, t0, t1, y0, ..., N = 100, zeta = 0.25, theta = 0.5)

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Second derivative y'' = f(t, y), with y of length 2.

arguments.name: N
arguments.text: Number of grid points, an integer greater than 1.

origin.details: y'' = -y, y(0) = 1, y'(0) = 0, eight points on [0, 0.5]. The check vector is the solution, column by column.
origin.value: Implicit Newmark step for one second-order equation. The state holds the value and its first derivative, and each stage is a Broyden root.
